paper_title: Narrative Media Framing in Political Discourse
caption: Distribution of articles across political leanings of the outlets
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of articles across four different political leanings of news outlets. The chart contains four slices representing “Right bias,” “Left bias,” “Left center bias,” and “Questionable source,” totaling 100%. The “Right bias” slice is orange and represents approximately 30.0%, while the “Left bias” slice is blue and represents approximately 28.0%. The “Left center bias” slice is green and accounts for approximately 22.0%. Finally, the “Questionable source” slice is red and comprises roughly 20.0%. The chart includes percentage labels displayed within each slice, and there is no accompanying legend. The slices appear ordered from largest to smallest in size, progressing clockwise from the “Right bias” to “Left bias” and then to “Left center bias” and “Questionable source”.
